question: The deficiency of which mineral may cause osteoporosis?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Calcium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **deficiency** of **calcium** causes **Osteoporosis**.
 
• The **deficiency** of calcium **reduces bone strength** which leads to **Osteoporosis**.
 
• Calcium provides strength to bones and teeth with **vitamins**.
 
• **Calcium** plays an **important role** in **blood formulation**.
 
• Calcium helps in **blood clotting**.
 
• Lack of vitamin D and **Calcium** can cause **rickets** in children and other **bone-related diseases in adults**.
 
• The main Sources of Calcium are **Milk, Cheese, eggs, grains, grams, fish**, etc. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Iron
 
 
 
• Plays an important role formation of Red Blood Corpuscles and Hemoglobin
 
• Iron deficiency causes Anemia.
 
 
 
 

 Sodium
 
 
 
• Controls positive Electrolyte balance in the body
 
• Sodium deficiency causes Hypoanetremia
 
 
 
 

 Fluoride
 
 
 
• Fluoride plays an important role in the formation and health of bones and teeth.
